title: Harness Leverage Across Model Size: A Ladder of Five Local Agent Harnesses from 0.75B to 4.7B
abstract: arXiv:2611.21407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A harness turns a model into a system that completes tasks: it builds the prompt, exposes tools and decides when work is done. Harness comparisons hold the model fixed. Model comparisons hold the harness fixed. We vary both: five shipped harnesses, 18 artifact-producing tasks, four locally deployable open-weight models from 0.75B to 4.7B and a 35.5B anchor, with one deterministic checker scoring all 360 ladder cells. The completion-controlling harness, Mingbird, has the highest mean at every size. Of four pre-registered paired contrasts, two survive Holm correction, at 0.75B and 4.7B. Thirteen of sixteen paired intervals exclude zero under the deployment reading, with leads from 0.075 over the strongest rival to 0.819 over the weakest. translated_title: 跨模型规模的 Harness 杠杆效应：从 0.75B 到 4.7B 的五级本地智能体框架阶梯
translated_abstract: Harness（智能体框架）将模型转化为一个能够完成任务的系统：它构建提示词、暴露工具，并决定工作何时算完成。以往的框架对比固定模型，模型对比固定框架，而本研究同时对两者进行变化：五个已发布的框架、18 个产出工件的任务、四个可本地部署的 0.75B 至 4.7B 开源权重模型，以及一个 35.5B 的锚点模型，并由一个确定性检查器对全部 360 个阶梯组合进行评分。控制任务完成的框架 Mingbird 在每个模型规模上都取得了最高的平均分。在四个预先注册的配对对比中，有两个在 Holm 校正后依然显著，分别位于 0.75B 和 4.7B 规模。在部署解读下，十六个配对置信区间中有十三个不包含零，领先幅度从对最强对手的 0.075 到对最弱对手的 0.819。完成门控并非优势的载体：禁用全部六个可执行检查后，平均分变化为 +0.080、+0.117、+0.003 和 -0.004，所有区间均包含零，只有在 1.9B 规模下禁用它才会产生可经验检测的影响。
tldr: 本文的核心贡献在于首次同时变化智能体框架与模型规模，通过五个本地框架、多个开源小模型与确定性评分器构成的 360 格实验阶梯，证明了框架选择（尤其是 Mingbird）在从 0.75B 到 4.7B 的每个模型规模上都能带来显著且可复现的性能提升，而这一优势并非来自其任务完成门控机制。
en_tdlr: By jointly varying both harness and model size in a 360-cell ladder of five local agent harnesses and open-weight models from 0.75B to 35.5B scored by a deterministic checker, this work demonstrates that harness choice (Mingbird) yields statistically significant performance leverage at every model scale, and that this advantage is not carried by its completion gate.
